FAQ
How often does my score update? +
Your score updates automatically after each weekly scan. You can also trigger a manual scan from the Reputation Command Center at any time.
What sources does TruthScan check? +
TruthScan verifies against 40+ databases including Reuters fact-check, AP Fact Check, Snopes, PolitiFact, major news archives and academic sources.
Can I dispute a claim verdict? +
Yes. Click any claim in TruthScan and use the "Dispute" option to submit evidence. Our team reviews within 48 hours.
How does IvoxIQ work? +
IvoxIQ connects to your WhatsApp or Telegram. Send natural language commands like "Check my trust score" and get instant AI-powered responses. Supports Nigerian Pidgin English.
Is my content data private? +
Yes. Your content is processed and stored securely. We never share your data with third parties. You can delete your account and all data at any time from Account & Billing.
Live ChatOnline

Our support team is online Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm GMT. Average response time: under 4 minutes.

How screening works
✓
6-month lookback across YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook + press mentions
✓
Human-verified per creator — AI classification is reviewed against context. A journalist reporting ON politics ≠ a creator endorsing a party
✓
Region-aware — political rules differ by market. Nigerian party endorsement is auto-block; UK MP interviews are not
△
Filter is advisory, not gospel — always review flagged creators against your specific campaign context before excluding
